rationale: An unquoted several-word text keeps its phrase reading on a search with a dependent parameter: the facts show the site's match of any of its words beside the count as the phrase, the exact-phrase question is answered from that count, and the organism the message names one letter off binds to the site's strain and shows as stated.

provenance.curatorNote: The organism is bound to the site's spelling, Giardia muris strain Roberts-Thomson, on every step. An unquoted several-word text is counted both ways, so the facts name both readings whatever fields the step searches; the counts depend on the fields and are not pinned.
